article.title: Digital Minimalism in Daily Life
article.content: Digital tools save time, but constant notifications can fragment attention. Digital minimalism means using technology with intention instead of habit. You can start by identifying which apps truly support your goals. Then disable nonessential alerts and set specific time windows for messages. Many people find that fewer interruptions lead to deeper work and calmer evenings. The aim is not to reject technology, but to make it serve your priorities.
article.translation: 数字工具能提高效率，但持续通知会切碎注意力。数字极简主义强调有目的地使用技术，而不是被习惯牵着走。你可以先识别哪些应用真正支持你的目标，再关闭不必要提醒，并为消息处理设定固定时间。很多人发现，打断更少后，工作更深入，晚间也更平静。目标不是拒绝技术，而是让技术服务于你的优先事项。
